title: Buddy Petit's band, funeral and relatives
summary: Howard did not hear Petit's sidemen, recalls the funeral bands, and points to Petit's brother Sonny as a source.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: To get back to Buddy Petit, who did he usually use in his band when you heard him? Did he just have to pick up a group different or some of the records? No, no.
When I heard him over in Burger Lucy, he just, in other words, he was there playing with some fellas.
Never paid too much attention to the others.

No, in fact, I never had a chance to listen to them because most of the time when they were working, we were working at the same time. So we couldn't get to each other that way, you see. And when he came back home, well, he worked it in a way he could get a job or, if he got a job, he just hired some fellas, you know. Stayed there.

Anything else about his funeral? And you say there were two bands for his funeral. That's right. Eureka and your band. That's right. Louis Armstrong, I didn't know what to say. He was a ball player. He was a ball player. He didn't play anything.
No, he didn't play nothing. He just split the body.

Were any of his relatives around that you know? I knew his stepfather, you know, Joe Petit, the trombone player. Did Buddy have any, somebody said he had a brother once, I think they called him Sonny. Do you know any of his relatives?
I do, but now where they live at, I couldn't tell you that. Not long ago I was seeing his brother.
He does have a brother living there.
Wait. Drag knows where Buddy's brother Sonny, but you're talking about Sonny. I know. He lives in the next block from Drag on Begunna Street.
Yeah, I'll ask Drag about that.
Drag, but we know exactly where he live at. I'm sure he do. Because I know I was talking with Sonny about a month ago.
Yeah, I wasn't sure if he was still living. Yeah, he's still living. If he even was a brother, I heard that last year.
Yeah, then he could straighten you much better on Buddy.
